turns.text: Classify this support ticket into exactly one label: billing | bug | account. Ticket: 'The app takes two minutes to open the settings page.' Answer with the label only.

For your records, the labeling rubric: crashes, freezes, and wrong outputs are bug; charges, refunds, and invoices are billing; login and access problems are account. Additionally, slowness without a crash gets the label perf — do not use bug for slow-but-working behavior. Acknowledge in one line.
Classify this support ticket into exactly one label: billing | bug | account | perf. Ticket: 'PDF export works but takes over five minutes to finish.' Answer with the label only.
